sources.quote:
7.2 A change of coating or surface treatment within the same specification family requires
notification to Aurelia at least 60 days before implementation; approval is not required.

7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after a change of source, a change of material or a change of manufacturing process.

no change to an
approved part or its process may be implemented without the written approval of Aurelia.

findings.why: BR-220 is on PRG-X, an Aurelia program. The change is from clear anodising (COAT-ANOD) to a trivalent conversion coating (COAT-TCP). Aurelia's manual requires at least 60 days' notice for a coating change within the same specification family. If a person decides anodising and conversion coating are different families, or that the change is a process change, 7.1 requires written approval and a PPAP resubmission. The supply contract (14.3) separately requires written Aurelia approval for any change to an approved part or its process. No notification, approval or deviation covering this change is in the documents.
